title: Project X Hub
features:
Perfect Skills – Run all Skill Check Events automatically with 100% accuracy.
Safe Gen (Panic Mode) – Automatically teleport the player to a secure area when detecting Killer nearby.
Speed Change – Allows you to change the overall speed of the character.
Speed Config – Custom character speed adjustment.
Vault Speed – Increases vault speed in windows and pallets.
Vault Config – Custom Vault speed adjustment.
 ESP Players – Displays the players' location in real time.
 Extra Info – Shows relevant additional information during departure.
Generators – Displays generator location and percentage progress.
Pallets – Highlights the position of pallets on the map.
Exits / Levers – Shows the location of outputs and levers.
Safe Exit Teleport – Teleport the character to a faraway exit from Killer.
Force End Game – Open the gates instantly, without needing to complete the generators.
Infinite Attack – Remove the reload time from Killer's attack.
